name: Simple Scroll
summary: A sealed scroll bearing Dannal Stern’s mark finds you while you deal with the Scourge. It calls you to Deathknell, where Dannal speaks of your freedom and offers to teach you.

sections.title: A Sealed Message
sections.body: While you were away dealing with the mindless Scourge, a scroll arrived for you. Its seal bears Dannal Stern’s mark. He is the warrior trainer in Deathknell, and the message asks you to read it and speak with him before setting out again.

sections.title: Freedom and Training
sections.body: Dannal says others escaped death and fled to town. He sees promise in their resilience. He credits Sylvanas with freeing you in body and spirit, though the plague still afflicts you. He offers to teach you as you gain experience. Sylvanas will need people of your class to help save the Forsaken.

faq.answer: The scroll bears Dannal Stern’s seal. He is the warrior trainer in Deathknell.
The scroll asks you to read it and speak with Dannal Stern in Deathknell.

faq.q: What does Dannal say about Sylvanas?
faq.answer: Dannal credits Sylvanas with freeing you in body and spirit, though the plague still afflicts you.
Dannal offers to teach you as you gain experience and invites you to seek him out.

faq.q: What does Sylvanas need from me?
faq.answer: Dannal says Sylvanas will need people of your class to help save the Forsaken.
